posts.en:
geml#integrations/dsh-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9a8559be2d8c5af8078b.html
